server.name: remix-of-remix-of-remix-of-remix-of-swift-stock
server.title: Remix of Remix of Remix of Remix of Swift Stock

tools.name: list_shops
tools.title: List shops
tools.description: List the shops set up in this account, with the name, phone number and receipt footer printed on their receipts.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List the product categories in the account, with the shop each one belongs to.

shop_id.description: Limit results to one shop id.

tools.name: list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the shop's products with stock levels, base price, variants and category. Optionally filter by name and show only items that are out of stock.

search.description: Filter products whose name contains this text.

only_out_of_stock.description: When true, return only products with no stock left.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (max 100).

tools.name: sales_summary
tools.title: Sales summary
tools.description: Summarise sales for a single day: how many sales, the money taken, and each receipt line. Defaults to today.

day.description: Day to summarise as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

shop_id.description: Limit the summary to one shop id.

tools.name: list_open_installments
tools.title: List open installments
tools.description: List customers still paying in installments, with what they owe, so you can follow them up.

shop_id.description: Limit results to one shop id.

tools.name: check_receipt
tools.title: Check a receipt
tools.description: Check whether a receipt is genuine using the verification code printed on it, and show the items and total recorded for that sale.

code.description: The verification code printed on the receipt.
